items.instruction: Confirm the instantiated checklist binds the exact candidate MP4 by artifact ID, byte count, and SHA-256 and that its basename is zhongguo-361-phase2-character-led.mp4.
Watch the exact candidate continuously from first frame to final frame at exactly 1.0x without skipping, scrubbing, fast playback, or substituting extracted frames.
Confirm picture and sound remain present, synchronized, intelligible, and uninterrupted throughout the candidate.
Confirm Chinese remains the primary visual and narration layer, English remains secondary, both tracks match the spoken meaning, timing is correct, and every line stays readable inside the safe area.
Confirm the first and final frames enter and exit cleanly and no launcher, loading screen, stale frame, or unintended desktop content appears.
Confirm all ten character-led chapters are watched continuously, their starts, ends, and declared boundaries match the storyboard, and all eight canonical gameplay spans appear in the declared order.
Confirm the audience can identify the lead historical official and the dramatic question within the first 35 seconds using only facts actually visible in the candidate.
Confirm every departure from the lead character has an intelligible organizational reason and is not presented as the lead's personal experience unless identity and same-case evidence support it.
Confirm adjacent edits, narration, sound design, and overlays do not fabricate unsupported same-person, same-case, chronological, or causal continuity.
Confirm every key identity, number, revision, branch label, and result surface used by a claim is shown completely and remains readable long enough at 1.0x.
Confirm each retained narration and subtitle claim is supported by its mapped canonical span and that no deleted or narrowed source-review claim was restored without new exact evidence and re-review.
Confirm every policy-covered visible character is historical or provenance-bound and no prohibited generated official name is visible.
Confirm fixture-only and test-only UI, debug overlays, test markers, launcher, loading screens, and obstructing system notifications are absent from the final composition.
Confirm compliance comes from clean source material and not from crop, mask, blur, redaction, or overlays that conceal disallowed content.

Confirm opening and finale cards are editorial framing only, and the final evidence card lists only spans actually included and does not claim complete, live-proven, exported, or published beyond the bound evidence.
Confirm this is a genuinely character-led edit with its own narration, subtitle timing, pacing, candidate bytes, and review chain rather than a retitled institution-led cut.
Confirm transitions, lower thirds, music, effects, and pacing are publication quality and do not obscure product evidence or imply that an action ACK proves an outcome.

project config, authoring overlay, and promo tool exact versions
